snippet.title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection - Official Premiere Trailer
snippet.description:
The complete iX series, refined. The apeX of 2D action reaches a new peak!
This "director's cut" is coming July 9th, 2026!
Official Site: https://gunvolt.com/XDC/

Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection brings together and updates the apeX of 2D action for new and old players alike.
The Dual Collection includes both Luminous Avenger iX 1 and 2, with all all DLC included, as well as balance adjustments. All that plus a brand new mode, Endless Battle, has been added to both games.

◆Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Features
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition will be able to swap between a high resolution (4k) display mode and high performance (120fps) mode.

Product Information
■Title: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection
■Platforms: Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PC (Steam)
■Genre: Action
■Rating: Pending
■Players: 1
■Release Date: July 9th, 2026
■Digital Price: TBA
